categories.label: Source authority and confidence
categories.assessment: Archive hashes and implementation bindings are checked. Full reconciliation against primary UFCStats records remains outstanding; assumed effects have no empirical authority.

categories.label: SQL/value accuracy
categories.assessment: Independent reproduction covers the historical profiles, baseline, calibration, tree, all reference Monte Carlo draws and sensitivity grids. Regression preserves the saved reference within 1e-12 (feature accumulation maximum 1.71e-13).

categories.label: Within-chart agreement
categories.assessment: Numerical chart encodings are covered by focused tests. Representative desktop/mobile plots and labels were inspected; no fabricated leader is assigned to exact ties.

categories.label: Complete source details
categories.assessment: Profiles, contributing bouts, denominators, partitions, assumptions, exclusions and reproducibility records remain inspectable. Separate custom sensitivity scopes are explicitly labeled.

categories.label: Cross-artifact consistency
categories.assessment: Context, configuration identity, current/previous status and copied HTML/JSON/CSV/ZIP records are tested together. The existing numerical engine and source/model bytes are preserved.

categories.label: Data-quality controls
categories.assessment: Earlier-date, same-day, missing-denominator, malformed-count, identity, format and outcome rules are tested. Primary-source reconciliation is outside the verified archive scope.

categories.label: Conclusion support
categories.assessment: Neutral equality and exploratory support status are preserved. A computed mean leader or colored grid region is not a causal or robust tactical recommendation.

categories.label: Analytical clarity
categories.assessment: Eight purposes have distinct navigation, full matchup context and next actions. Observed, estimated, assumed and calculated information use explicit nearby language.

categories.label: Visual and interaction consistency
categories.assessment: Eight views inspected; four representative views at all five requested resolutions. Contrast and keyboard focus measured. True 200% embedded-browser zoom and screen-reader behavior remain unverified.

categories.label: Dashboard usefulness and completeness
categories.assessment: The eight existing functions, staged inputs, explicit calculations, sensitivity and four export formats remain available. Native multi-file upload, snapshot validation, result/export invalidation and source restoration were observed with explicitly synthetic test files.
